card.name: Methods-section wording in research papers
card.fires_on: Verbs, sentence ends and linking words inside the methods part of scientific papers, where the authors describe how an analysis, simulation or measurement was done. Examples are 'choosing', 'performed', 'eliminating' and the period after 'this antenna'.

modes.label: Method verbs
modes.description: Action verbs describing how an analysis or simulation was carried out.
modes.example: a simulation was performed using MATLAB Simulink simulation software from The MathWorks,<< choosing>> 2000 to 5

modes.label: Sentence end in methods
modes.description: The period closing a sentence about how data were counted or measured.
modes.example: was counted for analysis<<.>> A single, blinded, independent adjudication

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Short words like to, as or because that introduce a purpose or reason in a methods sentence.
modes.example: All participants were surveyed<< to>> assess their level of sun-protective
